answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold blocks fake identities. A new agent locks 50 credits in a vault, then must serve 12 distinct counterparties in 20 epochs; one sponsor or a cluster does not count. Faking breadth costs: 100 fakes need 1,200 partners and 5,000 credits, like grains building a dune. An honest agent pays only 50 and keeps its reward once its nebula of clients checks out; sybils sharing partners are flagged and lose deposits.
